E01.rationale: The supplier states a specific new price per lb for EPDM 70 duro compound with an old price and an effective date of Nov 1, 2026; other EPDM grades are unchanged and excluded.

E02.rationale: Supplier announces a firm new price of USD 5.20 per kg for NBR 70 compound effective 15 November 2026, with no old price or percent change stated.

E03.rationale: Supplier announces a firm new price of $310.00 per 25 kg bag (previously $281.10) effective 2026-11-01; the pallet quantity of 40 bags is unchanged and not a price.

E04.rationale: Forwarded notice states EPDM 70 duro compound moving from $2.10/lb to $2.27/lb effective Nov 1, 2026; other EPDM grades unchanged and so excluded.

E05.rationale: The supplier announces a specific price reduction for one material, with old and new prices per lb and a stated effective date.

E06.rationale: The email is a holiday shipping schedule notice that explicitly says pricing is unchanged, so it contains no price change.

E07.rationale: The supplier states a specific new price of $2.30/lb for Black 70 compound effective November 1, 2026, so it is a firm price change.

E08.rationale: Supplier announces a 6.5% increase on FKM 75 effective December 1, 2026, with no absolute prices or units stated.

E09.rationale: Supplier states a specific new price of $118.00/cwt for N550 carbon black effective Nov 1, 2026, with the previous price of $109.00/cwt.

E10.rationale: Supplier states a specific new price per metric ton with prior price and a November 1, 2026 effective date for C1018 cold rolled bar.

E11.rationale: The supplier announces a 5% increase on NR 40 compound effective 2027-02-01, with no absolute price or unit stated.

E12.rationale: The supplier announces new per-lb prices for EPDM 50 and SBR 60 effective 2026-11-15, with old prices stated; EPDM 60 and 70 are mentioned only as unchanged and are excluded.

E13.rationale: The reminder restates a price change already in effect: EPDM 60 compound at $2.05/lb effective 2026-10-01, with no old price or percentage given.

E14.rationale: A trading company sales pitch offering EPDM 70 at $1.80/lb with a minimum order and a sample request, not an announced change to an existing supply price.

E15.rationale: The supplier gives a heads-up of expected 3-5% increases in Q1 2027 with no exact price or firm date, and says formal notices will follow in December.
